about: The one register of dates typed into this repository that change what a visitor or Google sees. scripts/audit-freshness.js reads it: `npm run audit:freshness` lists anything inside its warning period, and fails if an entry no longer matches the code. A weekly GitHub Action runs the same check and opens an issue. When you type a date into a file, or change one listed here, change this file in the same commit.

fields.what: What the date is, in plain words.
fields.find: The exact text in that file that carries the date. The audit fails if it is not there, so the register cannot drift from the code.
fields.date: The date itself, or for a reminder the day by which someone must act (YYYY-MM-DD, London).
fields.warnDays: How many days before the date the audit starts to list it.
fields.whenItPasses: What a visitor or Google sees once the date has passed.
fields.action: What a person needs to do, and by when.
fields.afterPassing: 'act' if it stays wrong until someone changes it (the audit keeps listing it), 'nothing' if the site handles the date by itself.

dates.what: The date both job adverts tell Google they expire.
dates.whenItPasses: Google treats the bar staff and kitchen team adverts as closed and drops them from job search.
dates.action: In April 2027: if still hiring, move recruitmentDatePosted and recruitmentValidThrough on a year. If not, remove the JobPosting data.

dates.what: The year in the private hire brochure titles and file names.
dates.whenItPasses: Brochure links across the site still say '2026' in 2027.
dates.action: Before 31 December 2026: supply the 2027 brochures, or make the titles year-neutral.

dates.what: A reminder, not a date a visitor sees: Christmas is set up for 2026 only. The year is in the SSOT block name.
dates.whenItPasses: Nothing Christmas shows for 2027: no header link, no cross-links, no pop-up, and the Christmas page says the season has finished.
dates.action: In June 2027: confirm the 2027 service window, kitchen break and prices in the management app, then update the SSOT block and the code that names it.

dates.what: The week the plane-spotting note counts from to say 'from 3pm' or 'until 3pm'.
dates.whenItPasses: If Heathrow's 2027 alternation programme does not carry straight on from 2026, the note is a week out: it says 'from 3pm' in an 'until 3pm' week.
dates.action: In early January 2027: check the start week against Heathrow's published 2027 runway alternation programme, then update the date here and in the file.

dates.what: When the Halloween page stops inviting people to the 2026 party.
dates.whenItPasses: The Halloween page switches by itself to saying the party has been and gone.
dates.action: Nothing on the day. When a 2027 party is confirmed, set the new date here and in the file.

dates.what: The last day of the Nations Championship header link and strips.
dates.whenItPasses: The header link and the strips go by themselves the next day.
dates.action: Nothing on the day. Set new dates here and in the file when the next tournament is confirmed.

dates.what: The last day of the Christmas pop-up.
dates.action: Nothing on the day. It is set up again with 'christmas-next-year'.

dates.whenItPasses: The Christmas page says enquiries have closed, then that the season has finished. The header link and cross-links go by themselves.
dates.action: Nothing on the day. It is set up again with 'christmas-next-year'.

checkedFiles.about: Files whose claims can go stale without anyone touching them. Each carries one or more `verifiedAt: 'YYYY-MM-DD'` stamps; `days` is how long a check stays good for. Owner of every claim: Peter Pitcher (decision 5, 26 August 2026).
